Name: Automatic Screenshot Taker
Author: Zamiell
Description:
Normally, when you enter a new mines floor (or a new Skull Caverns floor), the first thing you do is pause the game, take a screenshot, and open the screenshot. This is done in order to study the floor for "free" staircases, diamond nodes, the number of enemies, and so on. Doing this over and over is extremely tedious, but necessary for high-level play.

But there's a better way. With this mod, upon entering a mines or Skull Cavern floor, the game will automatically be paused and a screenshot will be taken.

Use this mod in conjunction with an automatic image viewer such as this: https://github.com/Zamiell/image-viewer
By putting the image viewer on your second monitor, you can automatically view the entire floor as soon as you enter it without having to do anything extra.

The source code for this mod can be found on GitHub at: https://github.com/Zamiell/AutomaticScreenshotTaker
